classes.measured: an existing compiled constant or committed build log value, cited
classes.proposed: no ceiling exists in source; a reasoned recommendation, never a fact
classes.measured-absent: a targeted search found no such capability; the value is zero and the capability is an explicit rejection

rt1062.description: DualMCU RT1062 real-time engine (AP+VP) behind the S3 radio bridge.
rt1062.control_path: BLE (console) -> S3 radio bridge -> K1BR SPI -> RT1062 engine

max_pages.source: docs/evidence/k1-programme-2026-09-24/platform/capacity-proposal.json dual.pages (no page constant exists); anchored on standalone K1_PRESET_SLOT_COUNT=10, the only persisted slot precedent. The engine holds only ProfileIdentity, so this bounds the console-compiled profile the engine will accept identities for.

max_targets.source: registry declares 61 targets (29 channel parameters x 2 + 3 global); codec capacity kMaxSnapshotEntries=64

max_snapshot_entries.source: = max_targets; StateSnapshot 92+20n+4 bytes fragments over TRN's reliable lane (<= 2 496 B per message)

max_transaction_ops.source: ControlTransaction 36+24*16 = 420 B fits TRN's 2 496 B fragmented message; covers one channel's preset recall

max_writers.source: console, companion editor, automation, external sync

duplicate_window.source: docs/evidence/k1-programme-2026-09-24/platform/capacity-proposal.json dual.transaction_queue_depth_ble_ordered 8 (measured) x 2, so every retry inside the ordered window finds its original receipt

max_label_bytes.source: docs/evidence/k1-programme-2026-09-24/platform/capacity-proposal.json dual.string_bytes_on_wire 0 (measured): labels are new bounded UTF-8 fields; binding/page label field width 16 B including NUL

persistence_slot_bytes.source: docs/evidence/k1-programme-2026-09-24/platform/capacity-proposal.json dual.persistence_bytes (measured-absent: no control/parameter store on RT1062)

lease_timeout_us.source: console scan 5 000 us and BLE interval 7.5-15 ms (measured, capacity-proposal console.*); 500 ms >> worst inter-sample gap; freeze from HMI movement cadence before target tests

ram_budget_bytes.source: docs/evidence/k1-programme-2026-09-24/platform/capacity-proposal.json dual.rt1062_t40_ram1_free_bytes_2026_09_20 = 243 328 B (measured); engine state budget is a proposal

ram_budget_bytes.source: docs/evidence/k1-programme-2026-09-24/platform/capacity-proposal.json console.lvgl_mem_size_bytes 49 152 (measured) sets the scale; one CompiledProfile plus a draft

notes: Compiled profiles stay console-side. Engines receive only ProfileIdentity; staged profile transfer to an engine is not advertised on any platform in this release (service profile_transfer absent everywhere).
Minimum product capability: two nine-fader default pages per channel plus one custom nine-fader page per channel wherever a platform advertises pages.
Every value marked proposed awaits measured budgets; admission on a target requires those measurements.
